senses.en: To match something or have an equivalent role or position.
To exchange letters or messages with someone.

ex.en: The assignment is to correspond to, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先对应于，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to correspond to.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来对应于。

tip: 对应常用correspond to；与人通信接with。

senses.en: Extremely large in area, size, amount, or degree.

ex.en: Our professor circled the vast majority on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了绝大多数。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the vast majority.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕绝大多数展开说明。

tip: the vast majority of表示……中的绝大多数。

senses.en: one part of something divided into separate sections
to divide something into separate parts or groups

ex.en: I copied market segment into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把细分市场抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around market segment.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕细分市场展开说明。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词读/seɡˈment/。

senses.en: Sadness caused by feeling alone or lacking close relationships

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on feelings of loneliness.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论孤独感。

ex.en: The author returns to feelings of loneliness when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了孤独感。

col: social isolation and loneliness｜社会隔离与孤独
tip: loneliness强调难过；solitude可指享受独处。

senses.en: able to spread disease between people or organisms
causing others to share the same feeling or behaviour

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly infectious.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论传染性很强的。

ex.en: A campus survey used highly infectious to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用传染性很强的来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: infectious表示有传染性；infected表示已被感染。

senses.en: Something that could cause harm, damage, or an accident.
To suggest something despite uncertainty about whether it is correct.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about health hazard.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于健康隐患的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of health hazard.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得健康隐患这个例子。

tip: 名词指危险来源；动词常见于hazard a guess。

senses.en: someone who studies past societies through objects and physical remains

ex.en: I copied a leading archaeologist into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把杰出的考古学家抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a leading archaeologist.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得杰出的考古学家这个例子。

col: a team of archaeologists｜一队考古学家
a leading archaeologist｜杰出的考古学家
a field archaeologist｜田野考古学家
tip: 考古研究人类遗存；研究恐龙的通常是古生物学家。

senses.en: A country whose head of state is not a monarch.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a parliamentary republic in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了议会制共和国。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a parliamentary republic.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论议会制共和国的材料。

col: a parliamentary republic｜议会制共和国
tip: 共和国没有君主，但并不必然实行民主制度。

senses.zh: 主席；董事长；会议主持人
senses.en: a person, usually a man, who leads a meeting or organisation

ex.en: I copied committee chairman into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把委员会主席抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used committee chairman to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用委员会主席来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 性别中性的表达可用chair或chairperson。

senses.en: Money or goods given to help a person or organisation.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about generous donation.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于慷慨的捐赠的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss generous donation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论慷慨的捐赠的材料。

tip: 常用make a donation to，表示向某方捐赠。

senses.en: An agreement that ends a dispute.
A place where people establish a community.
The payment of money owed.

ex.en: Office hours began with a peace settlement.
ex.zh: 答疑从和平协议开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a peace settlement when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了和平协议。

tip: 可指争议的解决协议，也可指人们居住的定居点。

senses.en: Repeated behaviour intended to hurt, frighten, or control someone
Repeatedly hurting or frightening someone with less power

ex.en: Our professor circled school bullying on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了校园霸凌。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss school bullying.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论校园霸凌的材料。

tip: 作名词通常不可数；也可作bully的现在分词。

senses.en: Presented as greater, worse, or more important than it really is
Made unusually large or noticeable for emphasis or effect

ex.en: I copied greatly exaggerated into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把大大夸大的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects greatly exaggerated with a larger point about public communication.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把大大夸大的和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 形容说法或表现被夸大；不要与“准确的”混用。

senses.en: a person or force entering a place without permission
an organism spreading into an area and threatening native life

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on biological invader.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论生物入侵者。

ex.en: A campus survey used biological invader to explain a pattern in historical change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用生物入侵者来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。

tip: invader指入侵者；invasion指入侵这一行为。

senses.en: Requiring no interest payments on borrowed money.

ex.en: The professor explained interest-free with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了免息的。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up interest-free while discussing evidence about economic policy.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了免息的。

tip: 免息不等于免费：本金仍须偿还。

senses.en: Impossible to see.
Not noticed or acknowledged by other people.

ex.en: Our professor circled almost invisible on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了几乎看不见的。

ex.en: The reading connects almost invisible with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把几乎看不见的和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: invisible to the naked eye｜肉眼看不见的
tip: invisible指看不见；与看不懂的incomprehensible不同。

senses.en: a subject or activity someone has particular knowledge or skill in
a food or product a person or place is known for

ex.en: Our professor circled medical specialty on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了医学专科。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of medical specialty.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得医学专科这个例子。

tip: 美式常用specialty；英式也常用speciality。

senses.en: A thin booklet giving information or arguments about a subject

ex.en: Our professor circled an information pamphlet on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了信息手册。

ex.en: The author returns to an information pamphlet when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了信息手册。

col: a pamphlet on health｜健康宣传册
tip: 通常指介绍专题的薄册子，比普通书籍篇幅短。

senses.en: An organized collection of information stored and accessed electronically.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on customer database.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论客户数据库。

ex.en: The author returns to customer database when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了客户数据库。

tip: 可数名词；在数据库中通常用 in a database。

senses.en: To make someone feel unhappy and without hope.
To reduce an amount, value, or level of activity.
To push something down.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to depress demand.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须抑制需求。

ex.en: The reading asks you to depress demand and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你抑制需求，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: depressed形容人感到沮丧，depressing形容事物令人沮丧。

senses.en: preparing or changing materials through a series of operations
using a computer to organise, change, or analyse information

ex.en: I copied food processing into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把食品加工抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around food processing.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕食品加工展开说明。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；processing plant指加工厂。

senses.en: A small stand or space where goods are sold.
To stop progress or deliberately delay action.
For an engine to stop unexpectedly, or cause this.

ex.en: Our professor circled market stall on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了市场摊位。

ex.en: A campus survey used market stall to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用市场摊位来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: stall an engine｜使发动机熄火
tip: 作动词可指发动机熄火，也可指谈判等陷入停滞。

senses.en: A light, gentle wind
Something that is very easy to do
Move or complete something easily and confidently

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a gentle breeze.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论轻柔的微风。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a gentle breeze.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论轻柔的微风的材料。

col: breeze through an exam｜轻松通过考试
tip: be a breeze是口语，表示“轻而易举”。

senses.en: Following established rules or officially recognised procedures.
Suitable for serious occasions rather than relaxed situations.
Organised and structured, especially within an educational institution.

ex.en: Office hours began with formal agreement.
ex.zh: 答疑从正式协议开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss formal agreement.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论正式协议的材料。

tip: formal不等于former：前者“正式的”，后者“以前的”。

senses.en: The practice of focusing attention to calm and train the mind.
Deep, careful thought about a particular subject.

ex.en: I copied practise meditation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把练习冥想抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects practise meditation with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把练习冥想和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 指冥想练习时通常不可数；meditation on可指对某事的沉思。

senses.en: A lamp directing a strong beam onto a small area.
Public attention directed towards a person or issue.
To draw particular attention to someone or something.

ex.en: I wrote spotlight on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把spotlight和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: Students who can explain spotlight usually follow the rest of a lecture on public communication.
ex.zh: 能解释聚光灯的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共传播的讲座。

col: in the spotlight｜处于公众关注之下
put the spotlight on｜使成为关注焦点
turn the spotlight on｜将注意力转向
tip: in the spotlight常比喻成为公众关注的焦点。

senses.en: The time when daylight fades before night.

ex.en: I wrote dusk on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把dusk和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up dusk while discussing evidence about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于自然科学的证据时提到了黄昏。

col: from dawn to dusk｜从黎明到黄昏
tip: 在黄昏用at dusk；dawn表示黎明。

senses.en: Feeling worried or uncomfortable about a situation.
Not fully settled, secure, or free from tension.

ex.en: Our professor circled an uneasy truce on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不稳固的停战。

ex.en: A campus survey used an uneasy truce to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用不稳固的停战来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: uneasy about something｜对某事感到担忧
an uneasy truce｜不稳固的停战
tip: uneasy意为不安，不是“不容易”；常接about。

senses.en: An improvement or development in a particular field
Move forward or help something develop
Done or provided before a particular time or event

ex.en: Our professor circled a major advance on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了重大进展。

ex.en: The reading connects a major advance with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把重大进展和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。

senses.en: The ability to live or act without relying on others.
A country's freedom from control by another country.

ex.en: Office hours began with financial independence.
ex.zh: 答疑从经济独立开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used financial independence to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用经济独立来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；independence from表示不依赖或不受控制。

senses.en: Extremely hot, especially when describing weather.

ex.en: Our professor circled scorching heat on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了酷热。

ex.en: A campus survey used scorching heat to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用酷热来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: 表示极热，常说scorching hot，一般不用very修饰。

senses.en: The process of judging an approximate amount, size, or value.
An opinion about someone's character or something's value.

ex.en: Office hours began with cost estimation.
ex.zh: 答疑从成本估算开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around cost estimation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕成本估算展开说明。

tip: estimation常指估算过程；具体估价常用estimate。

senses.en: A plant whose dried leaves are used to make smoking products

ex.en: The textbook introduces tobacco products in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了烟草制品。

ex.en: The reading connects tobacco products with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把烟草制品和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；一片烟叶用a tobacco leaf。

senses.en: a group chosen to discuss, judge, or advise
a flat piece forming part of a surface
a surface containing controls or instruments

ex.en: I copied a judging panel into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把评审团抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a judging panel to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用评审团来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: a panel of experts｜专家小组
tip: 专家组用a panel of experts；成员称panellist。

senses.en: Made from clay or similar materials hardened by heat.
A material hardened by heat, or an object made from it.

ex.en: Office hours began with ceramic tiles.
ex.zh: 答疑从陶瓷砖开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used ceramic tiles to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用陶瓷砖来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

tip: ceramics可指陶瓷制品，也可指陶艺或陶瓷工艺。

senses.en: Too small or unimportant to have much effect.

ex.en: Office hours began with statistically insignificant.
ex.zh: 答疑从统计上不显著的开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of statistically insignificant.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得统计上不显著的这个例子。

col: an insignificant amount｜微不足道的量
tip: 强调不重要或影响小，不等同于meaningless。

senses.en: To ask for divine protection or favour for someone or something.
To give someone something good or fortunate.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to bless you.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何愿你安好。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to bless you.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得愿你安好。

tip: be blessed with表示有幸拥有某种优点或资源。

senses.en: An event causing great suffering, sadness, or loss.
A serious play or story ending in suffering or death.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a terrible tragedy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了可怕的惨剧。

ex.en: The reading connects a terrible tragedy with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可怕的惨剧和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 既指现实中的惨事，也指文学悲剧；后者与comedy相对。

senses.en: A gathering of people for a shared purpose.
The process of joining parts to make something complete.
A group elected to discuss public matters and make laws.

ex.en: Office hours began with school assembly.
ex.zh: 答疑从学校集会开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used school assembly to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用学校集会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 集会义通常可数；组装义通常不可数。

senses.en: Make someone less willing or likely to do something
Make someone lose confidence or hope

ex.en: The professor asked us to discourage car use.
ex.zh: 教授让我们减少汽车使用意愿。

ex.en: The reading asks you to discourage car use and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你减少汽车使用意愿，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: discourage someone from doing something｜劝阻某人做某事
discourage car use｜减少汽车使用意愿
tip: 用discourage sb from doing，不用from to do。

senses.en: A tiny burning particle or a brief flash of electricity.
To cause something to begin or develop suddenly.
A small amount of a quality, or something initiating change.

ex.en: Office hours began with electrical spark.
ex.zh: 答疑从电火花开始。

ex.en: The author returns to electrical spark when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了电火花。

col: a spark of hope｜一丝希望
tip: 作动词可直接接interest、debate等，表示“引发”。

senses.en: to increase quickly to a very high level
to fly high in the air, often without moving wings

ex.en: The professor asked us to soar above.
ex.zh: 教授让我们在……上空翱翔。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to soar above.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来在……上空翱翔。

col: soar to record levels｜飙升至创纪录水平
tip: 表示价格等猛涨时为不及物动词，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: A sudden strong desire to act without thinking carefully.
A brief electrical signal travelling through a nerve or circuit.
Something that encourages an activity or development.

ex.en: I copied impulse buying into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把冲动购物抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around impulse buying.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕冲动购物展开说明。

col: resist the impulse to｜克制做……的冲动
tip: on impulse表示一时冲动；后接动作常用impulse to do。

senses.en: A book giving practical information or instructions about a subject

ex.en: Office hours began with employee handbook.
ex.zh: 答疑从员工手册开始。

ex.en: The author returns to employee handbook when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了员工手册。

tip: 指便于查阅的实用指南，不是普通课本。

senses.en: not working during a particular period

ex.en: I wrote off-duty on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把off-duty和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses off-duty when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了下班的。

col: an off-duty nurse｜不当班的护士
tip: 名词前用off-duty；作表语通常写off duty。

senses.en: correct and free from mistakes
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: I copied highly accurate into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把高度精确的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of highly accurate.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得高度精确的这个例子。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.en: showing politeness and consideration towards someone or something

ex.en: Our professor circled respectful attitude on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了尊重他人的态度。

ex.en: The reading connects respectful attitude with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把尊重他人的态度和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: respectful尊重他人的；respectable值得尊敬的。

senses.en: Relating to atomic nuclei or the energy they release.
Relating to the nucleus of a cell.

ex.en: Office hours began with nuclear energy.
ex.zh: 答疑从核能开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss nuclear energy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论核能的材料。

tip: nuclear可指原子核或细胞核，依语境判断。

senses.en: An official rule controlling how something must be done.
The process of controlling an activity or maintaining a condition.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on government regulation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论政府监管。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around government regulation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕政府监管展开说明。

tip: 具体条例可数；表示监管这一过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: attractive and graceful in appearance or style
simple and effective in solving a problem

ex.en: Office hours began with elegant design.
ex.zh: 答疑从雅致的设计开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around elegant design.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕雅致的设计展开说明。

col: elegant solution｜简洁巧妙的解决方案
tip: 既可形容外观优雅，也可形容方案简洁巧妙。

senses.en: Someone who risks money on uncertain outcomes
Someone willing to take risks for possible rewards

ex.en: I copied problem gambler into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把有赌博问题的人抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around problem gambler.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕有赌博问题的人展开说明。

tip: gamble是赌博或冒险；gambler指从事这种行为的人。

senses.en: Being the final or most important aim or result.
The best or most extreme example of something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on ultimate goal.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论最终目标。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of ultimate goal.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得最终目标这个例子。

col: the ultimate in comfort｜极致舒适
tip: ultimate强调最终目标或极致，不指最近一次。

senses.en: control an activity through rules or laws
adjust something to maintain a suitable level or rate

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to regulate an industry.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何监管一个行业。

ex.en: The passage says students who can regulate an industry follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够监管一个行业的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: regulate an industry｜监管一个行业
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；regulate temperature指调温。

senses.en: a setting used automatically unless you choose another
failure to pay a debt or fulfil a legal obligation
to fail to pay a debt or meet an obligation

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on debt default.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论债务违约。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of debt default.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得债务违约这个例子。

col: default on a loan｜拖欠贷款
tip: by default 表示默认；拖欠贷款用 default on a loan。

senses.en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose
to officially give someone something they request
to accept that something is true, often reluctantly

ex.en: I copied research grant into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把研究拨款抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used research grant to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用研究拨款来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

col: apply for a grant｜申请补助金
take something for granted｜认为某事理所当然
tip: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。

senses.en: someone authorised to assist or act for a more senior person
an elected member of parliament in some countries

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on act as deputy.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论担任代理人。

ex.en: A campus survey used act as deputy to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用担任代理人来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 常置于职务前，如deputy director；不泛指所有代表。

senses.en: Done without enough thought about possible risks or consequences.
An area of irritated skin covered with spots.

ex.en: I copied a skin rash into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把皮疹抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a skin rash with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把皮疹和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 作形容词指鲁莽；作名词指皮疹，常用a rash。

senses.en: Parts left after something has been used, damaged, or destroyed.
Surviving parts of ancient buildings or objects.
The body or bones of a dead person or animal.

ex.en: Our professor circled archaeological remains on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了考古遗迹。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of archaeological remains.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得考古遗迹这个例子。

col: the remains of a meal｜餐后剩余物
tip: 作名词用复数谓语；也可为remain的单数动词形式。

senses.en: the base remaining after a tree or object is cut
to leave someone unable to answer or solve something

ex.en: Office hours began with a tree stump.
ex.zh: 答疑从树桩开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a tree stump.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕树桩展开说明。

col: be stumped by a question｜被问题难倒
tip: be stumped by表示被难倒，并非被绊倒。

senses.en: To bring food or liquid from the stomach through the mouth.
Food or liquid brought up from the stomach.

ex.en: The professor asked us to vomit repeatedly.
ex.zh: 教授让我们反复呕吐。

ex.en: The reading asks you to vomit repeatedly and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你反复呕吐，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 名词指呕吐物；呕吐这一过程常用vomiting。

senses.en: a major change in government, often achieved by force
a dramatic change in how something works or is done
one complete turn around a point or axis

ex.en: The textbook introduces political revolution in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了政治革命。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of political revolution.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得政治革命这个例子。

tip: revolution强调根本变革；reform通常指渐进改革。

senses.en: the use of resources, energy, goods, or services
the act or amount of eating or drinking something

ex.en: The textbook introduces energy consumption in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了能源消耗。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss energy consumption.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论能源消耗的材料。

col: fit for human consumption｜适合人类食用
tip: 通常不可数；消费的人是consumer，不是consumption。

senses.en: continuing or having effects over a long period

ex.en: After the lecture, we used long-term in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了长期的。

ex.en: A reading on academic research uses long-term when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了长期的。

tip: 作定语常用连字符；in the long term不加。

senses.zh: 坐立不安的；难以休息的
senses.en: Unable to relax, stay still, or sleep peacefully.
Eager for change because the present situation feels unsatisfying.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about grow restless.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于变得焦躁不安的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around grow restless.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕变得焦躁不安展开说明。

col: a restless spirit｜不甘安定的性情
tip: restless指难以安静；restful指令人放松的。

senses.en: relating to mathematics

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mathematical model.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论数学模型。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of mathematical model.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得数学模型这个例子。

tip: mathematics是学科名，虽以s结尾但用单数谓语。

senses.en: Unfair treatment or a particular example of it.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on social injustice.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论社会不公。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around social injustice.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕社会不公展开说明。

col: a sense of injustice｜不公平感
suffer an injustice｜遭受不公正待遇
tip: 泛指不公时不可数；具体不公事件可用 an injustice。

senses.en: A book or other product that sells in very large quantities.

ex.en: Our professor circled international bestseller on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了国际畅销书。

ex.en: A campus survey used international bestseller to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用国际畅销书来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

tip: 指畅销书或商品，不指畅销书作者。

senses.en: A unit of land area equal to about 4,047 square metres

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an acre of land.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一英亩土地的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects an acre of land with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一英亩土地和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an acre of land｜一英亩土地
tip: 面积单位：1英亩约4047平方米，不等于一公顷。

senses.en: The process of developing or bringing something into existence.
A natural structure with a particular shape or arrangement.
An organised arrangement of people, vehicles, or animals.

ex.en: I copied cloud formation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把云的形成抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around cloud formation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕云的形成展开说明。

col: the formation of a government｜政府的组建
tip: formation可指形成过程，也可指形成的结构或队形。

senses.en: involving much work or effort within a short period
using large amounts of resources to produce high output

ex.en: The textbook introduces an intensive course in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了强化课程。

ex.en: A campus survey used an intensive course to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用强化课程来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: intensive 强调集中投入；intense 强调感受或程度强烈。

senses.en: Thin ice crystals on surfaces, or weather that forms them.
To cover or become covered with a thin layer of ice.
To cover a cake with a sweet, creamy topping.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a sharp frost in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了严重霜冻。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sharp frost.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕严重霜冻展开说明。

col: frost a cake｜给蛋糕涂糖霜
tip: frost是霜，不是雪；涂糖霜这一动词义多见于美语。

senses.en: Exactly and accurately, without any difference or error.
Used to emphasize that something is exactly the case.

ex.en: The lab manual says to precisely measure before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先精确测量，再记下数字。

ex.en: Students who precisely measure are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够精确测量的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: precisely because表示“正是因为”，强调原因。

senses.en: to identify an illness by examining symptoms and test results
to identify the cause or nature of a problem

ex.en: The professor asked us to diagnose a disease.
ex.zh: 教授让我们诊断疾病。

ex.en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers diagnose a disease before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要诊断疾病。

tip: 诊断某人患病用diagnose someone with某病。

senses.en: A gas whose molecules each contain three oxygen atoms.

ex.en: Office hours began with ground-level ozone.
ex.zh: 答疑从近地面臭氧开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss ground-level ozone.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论近地面臭氧的材料。

tip: 臭氧不可数；高空臭氧有保护作用，近地面臭氧有害。

senses.en: A temporary job that provides practical experience during training.
The act of putting something in a particular position.
The act of finding someone a suitable position or home.

ex.en: I copied job placement into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把就业安置抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects job placement with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把就业安置和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 英式英语中work placement常指课程中的实习。

senses.en: the way information or an event is arranged or presented
to arrange the appearance of a document or information
to prepare a storage device so it can store data

ex.en: Our professor circled file format on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了文件格式。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss file format.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论文件格式的材料。

col: format a document｜设置文档格式
tip: 动词过去式formatted，现在分词formatting。

senses.en: To strongly encourage someone to do something.
A strong desire to do something.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to urge caution.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求力劝谨慎行事。

ex.en: The reading asks you to urge caution and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你力劝谨慎行事，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: urge someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事
a strong urge to｜想……的强烈冲动
tip: 动词用urge sb to do；名词用an urge to do。

senses.en: Relating to the structure or management of an organization.
Relating to planning activities and arranging things effectively.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on organizational structure.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论组织架构。

ex.en: A campus survey used organizational structure to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用组织架构来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 英式也写作organisational。

senses.en: Neither very large nor very small in amount or degree
Avoiding extreme political views or actions
To become or make something less extreme or intense

ex.en: Our professor circled moderate exercise on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了适度运动。

ex.en: A campus survey used moderate exercise to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用适度运动来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: moderate your expectations｜适当降低期望
tip: 形容词末尾读/ət/，动词末尾读/eɪt/。

senses.en: willing to help others or work together
a business owned and run jointly by its members

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on agricultural cooperative.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论农业合作社。

ex.en: A campus survey used agricultural cooperative to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用农业合作社来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 作形容词表示合作；作名词指合作社。

senses.en: done by choice rather than because it is required
done without payment to help people or an organisation

ex.en: I copied voluntary work into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把志愿工作抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of voluntary work.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得志愿工作这个例子。

tip: voluntary是形容词；“志愿者”用volunteer。

senses.en: To become involved in others' affairs without being wanted.
To prevent something from working or progressing properly.

ex.en: The assignment is to interfere in someone's affairs, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先干涉某人的事务，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to interfere in someone's affairs and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你干涉某人的事务，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: interfere in someone's affairs｜干涉某人的事务
tip: interfere in多指干涉事务；with多指妨碍正常进行。

senses.en: To put someone in prison or keep them confined.

ex.en: The assignment is to imprison someone for life, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先终身监禁某人，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to imprison someone for life and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你终身监禁某人，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: imprison someone for life｜终身监禁某人
tip: be imprisoned for后可接罪名，也可接监禁时长。

senses.en: Without needing help or support from others.
Separately, without being connected to or influenced by something else.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to independently of.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习不依赖于；独立于。

ex.en: Students who independently of are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够不依赖于；独立于的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 表示“不依赖于……”用independently of。

senses.en: The ability to use a language easily and smoothly.
The quality of performing an activity smoothly and confidently.

ex.en: I copied oral fluency into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把口语流利度抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of oral fluency.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得口语流利度这个例子。

tip: 通常不可数；表示某种语言的流利程度用fluency in。

senses.en: The feeling of needing or wanting something to drink.
A strong desire to have or learn something.

ex.en: Office hours began with quench your thirst.
ex.zh: 答疑从解渴开始。

ex.en: The reading connects quench your thirst with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把解渴和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a thirst for adventure｜对冒险的渴望
tip: 口渴常说be thirsty；thirst for表示对……的渴望。

senses.en: to be greater than a particular amount, limit, or expectation

ex.en: The assignment is to exceed expectations, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先超出预期，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to exceed expectations.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来超出预期。

tip: 及物动词，直接接数量或限度，不加than。

senses.en: relating to official relations between countries
handling people sensitively to avoid offence or conflict

ex.en: Office hours began with diplomatic relations.
ex.zh: 答疑从外交关系开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of diplomatic relations.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得外交关系这个例子。

col: a diplomatic solution｜外交解决方案
tip: 既可指国家间外交，也可形容说话处事得体。

senses.en: Someone who takes part in an activity or event.

ex.en: I copied active participant into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把积极参与者抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects active participant with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把积极参与者和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: participant in a study｜研究参与者
tip: 常作名词；表示某活动的参与者用participant in。

senses.en: A short performance to show suitability for a performing role.
Perform or test someone for a role in a production.

ex.en: The professor explained audition with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了试演。

ex.en: Students who can explain audition usually follow the rest of a lecture on the humanities.
ex.zh: 能解释试演的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人文学科的讲座。

col: audition for a role｜为某个角色试镜
tip: 现代常用义是试演、试镜，不是一般的听力。

senses.en: a baby or very young child
relating to babies or an early stage of development

ex.en: Our professor circled infant care on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了婴儿护理。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around infant care.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕婴儿护理展开说明。

tip: 比baby正式；infant mortality专指婴儿死亡率。

senses.en: To a particular degree when compared with something else.

ex.en: The professor told us to comparatively low and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们相对较低的，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will comparatively low when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会相对较低的。

tip: 常修饰形容词原级，如comparatively cheap。

senses.en: A belief that something will happen.
A standard of success or behaviour someone hopes for.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used expectation in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了预期。

ex.en: Students who can explain expectation usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
ex.zh: 能解释预期的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。

col: in expectation of｜预料到；期待着
tip: 表示对表现的期望时常用复数expectations。

senses.en: Easily affected by emotions, substances, or changes
Aware of and considerate towards other people's feelings
Requiring careful handling because of possible harm or offence

ex.en: The textbook introduces sensitive skin in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了敏感皮肤。

ex.en: A campus survey used sensitive skin to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用敏感皮肤来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: sensitive指敏感的；sensible指明智的，勿混淆。

senses.en: Strong, heavy cloth used for tents, bags, and sails.
Cloth used for painting, or a painting on this cloth.

ex.en: The textbook introduces oil on canvas in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了布面油画。

ex.en: The author returns to oil on canvas when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了布面油画。

tip: 帆布作材料时不可数；指一幅油画时可数。

senses.en: an admission that you have done something wrong
the act of admitting sins, especially to a priest

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a false confession.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于虚假供认的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to a false confession when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了虚假供认。

tip: confession to 后接名词或动名词；不表示“自由”。

senses.en: in a way that people generally can see or know
through government or community funding or ownership

ex.en: The lab manual says to publicly available before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先公众可获取的，再记下数字。

ex.en: A lecture on social change asks the class to publicly available before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先公众可获取的。

col: publicly funded｜由公共资金资助的
tip: 拼写是publicly，不是publically。

senses.en: easy to reach, enter, obtain, or use
easy for people to understand

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on wheelchair accessible.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可供轮椅通行的。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around wheelchair accessible.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕可供轮椅通行的展开说明。

col: accessible to everyone｜人人可使用的
tip: 常用accessible to sb；易懂的内容也可用此词。

senses.en: A reddish-brown substance that forms on iron exposed to moisture.
To develop rust or cause metal to develop rust.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on remove rust.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论除锈。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of remove rust.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得除锈这个例子。

tip: 技能生疏常用rusty：My French is rusty。

senses.en: Covered with clouds, making the sky dull and grey.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an overcast sky.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于阴云密布的天空的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an overcast sky.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论阴云密布的天空的材料。

col: an overcast sky｜阴云密布的天空
tip: 指天空被云层覆盖，不一定下雨。
